title: Negotiating and persuading / Wadaadid iyo adoojiye
bridge: Faransiis, si aad u adoojiyo waxaan ku isticmaamo qoraal adag oo kala duwan 'deberías' ama 'tienes que', iyo subjunctive xukunka 'para que'. Ingiriisi, B2 wuxuu kaa talyo ayuu u adag oo adag yahay iyo mid adag oo adag yahay, isticmaal 'would', 'could', 'might' iyo 'I was wondering if...'. Xishooda inaad u turjumo 'hacer una contraoferta' si toogtoahay 'to make a counteroffer' (saxiixda ah) laakiin fiilka 'to suggest' ma uu qaadan subjunctive Ingiriisi, laakiin qoraalka ugu horreysa ee fiilka (suggest + infinitive). Si kastaba ha ahaatee, 'tag questions' si ay u talaan gelin ay yaanay aqoon (isn't it?) ma ay noqon doonin '¿no?', maxaa yeelay Ingiriisi waa inay isku dhafan la auxiliary xukunka guud.
rule: Si aad u adoojiyo iyo adoojiyo Ingiriisi B2, waxaa isticmaalaya: 1) Fiilka modal si ay u adag yihiin: 'would' (I would appreciate...), 'could' (Could we...), 'might' (That might work). 2) Buundhihii adag: 'I was wondering if...', 'Would it be possible to...?', 'If you could..., that would be...'. 3) Hadalka si ay u adag yihiin: 'That's a fair point, but...', 'I see what you mean, however...'. 4) Hadalka si ay u adag yihiin: 'What if we...?', 'How about...? + -ing', 'Would you be open to...?'. 5) Xukunka conditional si ay u adag yihiin: 'If we lowered the price, would you buy two?' (labada conditional). Adoojiye, waxaa isticmaalaya hadalka oo kala duwan 'Think of it this way...', 'The way I see it...', 'It's worth considering that...'. Muhiim: Ingiriisi, 'suggest' iyo 'recommend' waxaa la qoraa la that + isaga + fiilka ugu horreysa (ilaa 's'), ama la gerund: 'I suggest that we wait' / 'I suggest waiting'. Ma isticmaalina subjunctive sida Faransiis.

concept_examples.text: Could we possibly meet halfway on the price?
concept_examples.translation: Sidee baa noogu dhaxeeyo qiimaha dhexdhexaad?
concept_examples.phonetic: /kʊd wi ˈpɒsəbli miːt ˌhæfˈweɪ ɒn ðə praɪs/

concept_examples.text: I was wondering if you might consider a discount for bulk orders.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan ku fiirsanaa haddii aad u adag kartid khasmalyo lacag la'aan oo kala duwan.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf ju maɪt kənˈsɪdər ə dɪskaʊnt fɔː bʌlk ˈɔːrdərz/

concept_examples.text: What if we extend the deadline by a week? That could work for both of us.
concept_examples.translation: Maxaa yeelay waxaan ku daray toddoba malood? Waxaas ay u shaqayn doontaa labada.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wɒt ɪf wi ɪkˈstend ðə dedlaɪn baɪ ə wiːk ðæt kʊd wɜːrk fɔːr boʊθ əv ʌs/

concept_examples.text: If you agree to a lower price, we'll sign the contract today.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii aad qabto qiimaha ugu hooseeyo, waxaan siin doonnaa mijaarta maanta.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju əˈɡriː tʊ ə loʊər praɪs wiːl saɪn ðə ˈkɒntrækt təˈdeɪ/

common_error.wrong: I suggest that we should wait until next week.
common_error.correct: I suggest that we wait until next week.
common_error.correct_alt: I suggest waiting until next week.
common_error.explanation: Khalaaddu wuxuu ka yimid isticmaalka qoraalka Faransiiska 'sugiero que debamos esperar' la fiilka 'should'. Ingiriisi, ka dib 'suggest' (iyo 'recommend', 'propose'), waxaa isticmaalaya subjunctive Ingiriisi, oo ah qoraalka ugu horreysa ee fiilka (ilaa 's' iyo ilaa 'should'). Waxaa isticmaal karo qoraalka la gerund si ay u ahaadaan badal. Muhiim inaad xusuustid in subjunctive Faransiiska ma uu turjumo si toos ah; Ingiriisi waxaa isticmaalaya qoraalka ugu horreysa ee fiilka si ay u dhexeeyaan dhammaan isagoo, ilaa 'he/she/it'.

examples.original: Would it be possible to get an extension?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd ɪt bi ˈpɒsəbl tə ɡet ən ɪkˈstenʃən/
examples.translation: Sidee baa ay noqon kartaa inaan helno wadtimiis?
examples.note: Waxaan isticmaalnay 'would' kala duwan 'will' si ay u adag yihiin, sida '¿Podría?' Faransiiska.

examples.original: I was wondering if you could lower the price.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɒz ˈwʌndərɪŋ ɪf ju kʊd ˈloʊər ðə praɪs/
examples.translation: Waxaan ku fiirsanaa haddii aad u gooqi kartid qiimaha.
examples.note: Qoraalka 'I was wondering if...' waa mid aan u isticmaalno wadaadid. Ha isticmaal 'I wondered' oo adag yahay.

examples.original: Could we possibly agree on a different payment schedule?
examples.phonetic: /kʊd wi ˈpɒsəbli əˈɡriː ɒn ə ˈdɪfrənt ˈpeɪmənt ˈʃedjuːl/
examples.translation: Sidee baa noogu dhaxeeyo miisaan kale ee lacag bixinta?
examples.note: 'Possibly' wuxuu ku darayaa adag. Faransiiska waxaan dhahay '¿Podríamos quizás?', laakiin 'possibly' waa inuu yimaado ka dib isaga.

examples.original: That's a fair point, but we can't go below ten percent.
examples.phonetic: /ðæts ə feər pɔɪnt bʌt wi kænt ɡəʊ bɪˈloʊ ten pəˈsent/
examples.translation: Waa nuqul xaggiisa, laakiin ma naga dhigari doono inaan ka hooseeyo toban shatanka.
examples.note: Ogtahani nuqulka kale ('That's a fair point') waa mid muhiim ka hor inta aad isku dhigo.

examples.original: If you agree to a longer contract, we could offer a better rate.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ju əˈɡriː tʊ ə ˈlɒŋɡər ˈkɒntrækt wi kʊd ˈɒfər ə ˈbetər reɪt/
examples.translation: Haddii ay qabto mijaarta oo dheer, waxaan u siin karay lacag bixinta wanaagsan.
examples.note: Labada conditional (if + dhibic, would/could) waxaa isticmaalaya shuruudaha xaaladda.

examples.original: How about reducing the quantity instead of the price?
examples.phonetic: /haʊ əˈbaʊt rɪˈdjuːsɪŋ ðə ˈkwɒntəti ɪnˈsted əv ðə praɪs/
examples.translation: Sidee baad u maleynaysaa inaad ka yarsato miisaan ka badan qiimaha?
examples.note: 'How about + -ing' waa qoraal aan u adag yahay inaad soo jeediso badal kale.

examples.original: Think of it this way: a lower upfront cost saves you money in the long run.
examples.phonetic: /θɪŋk əv ɪt ðɪs weɪ ə loʊər ʌpˈfrʌnt kɒst seɪvz ju ˈmʌni ɪn ðə lɒŋ rʌn/
examples.translation: Fiirsidee: kharash buuxinta ugu horeeya wuxuu ku fiicayaa lacag dheer.
examples.note: Hadalka 'Think of it this way' waa mid aan u adag yahay inaad soo celisid fiirfuurka.

examples.original: Would you be open to a trial period for three months?
examples.phonetic: /wʊd ju bi ˈoʊpən tʊ ə ˈtraɪəl ˈpɪəriəd fɔː θriː mʌnθs/
examples.translation: Sidee baad u maleynaysaa inaad qabto muddo toddoba bilood?
examples.note: 'Open to' waa hadal fiil oo aan lahaan mid toban oo isku mid ah Faransiiska; wuxuu yahay 'diyaar inuu u fiiriyo'.

examples.original: If we meet your deadline, will you extend the payment terms?
examples.phonetic: /ɪf wi miːt jɔːr dedlaɪn wɪl ju ɪkˈstend ðə ˈpeɪmənt tɜːmz/
examples.translation: Haddii aannu u dhammayno wakhtigaada, sidee baad u maleynaysaa inaad ku darato shuruudaha lacag bixinta?
examples.note: Kowda conditional (if + hadda, will) waxaa isticmaalaya shuruudaha xaqiiq ah iyo siinayaa asas si ay u adag yihiin.

examples.original: I'm confident we can find a solution that works for both sides.
examples.phonetic: /aɪm ˈkɒnfɪdənt wi kæn faɪnd ə səˈluːʃən ðæt wɜːks fɔːr boʊθ saɪdz/
examples.translation: Waxaan rumaynay inaan helay hallab oo shaqayn doono labada.
examples.note: Isticmaal 'I'm confident' kala duwan 'I think' si ay u adag yihiin iyo si ay u adag yihiin inaad adoojiyo.

title: Giving and justifying opinions in depth / Siinayo iyo u jeediyeya arraaiso
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, waxaa amaana ah in la isticmaalo 'anigu waxaan u maleynayaa' ama 'waxaan u maleynayaa' oo la jeediya 'maxaa yeelahay'. Af-Ingiriisi, si aad u jeediyeya ugu dhakhsaha ah waxaad u baahan doontaa in aad soo bandhigto ideyada la isticmaalaya arrimaha 'the reason being', 'due to', 'given that', iyo xukummadka shartiga ah oo 'if... then...'. Ka tiraa tarjumadda adag 'según mi opinión' (oo ah 'according to my opinion' - qalad, waxaa lagama hadlaa 'in my opinion'). Af-Ingiriisi, isku xiga verbsiga modal (would, could) waxay u muhiimsan yihiin inay u qalafiyeen arraaiso iyo inay u muujiyaan xanuun.
rule: Si aad u siinayo arraaiso ugu dhakhsaha ah af-Ingiriisi, isticmaala: 1) Arrimaha arraaiso: 'In my view', 'From my perspective', 'I would argue that', 'It seems to me that'. 2) Jeediyeya: 'The reason for this is', 'This is due to', 'Given that', 'Considering that'. 3) Isbeddel: 'However', 'On the other hand', 'While it is true that...', 'Nevertheless'. 4) Shuruudaha u malaynayo: 'If... then', 'Unless...', 'Provided that...'. 5) Xukummadka sabab iyo natiijo: 'This leads to', 'As a result', 'Consequently'. Darajad B2: Waxaa laga baaba'inayaa in la isticmaalo soo bandhigga xanuun iyo lugaha qalad ah si haboon. Fiirso meeshii loo adeegayo adverbyada marta iyo doortidda waqtiga fiicni ah (present perfect vs. past simple) markaad siinayo misaal.

concept_examples.text: In my view, remote work has increased productivity, the reason being that employees avoid long commutes.
concept_examples.translation: Arraweeyaan, shaqo-gargaarka u dhaqmaynta wuxuu u badiyey noocyada, sababtaas oo ah in shaqaalaha ay u jeedsadaan safarka dheer.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ vjuː, rɪˈmoʊt wɜːrk hæz ˈɪnkriːst ˌprɒdʌkˈtɪvəti, ðə ˈriːzn ˈbiːɪŋ ðæt ˌemploʊˈiːz əˈvɔɪd lɔːŋ kəˈmjuːts/

concept_examples.text: I would argue that investing in education yields long-term benefits, given that it improves social mobility.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa in ku shaacayaasha waxbarashada ay u soo saartaa faa’iido yar-dhexe, maxaa yeelahay ay u sii noqoto mobbadii kulaylka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wʊd ˈɑːrgjuː ðæt ɪnˈvestɪŋ ɪn ˌedʒuˈkeɪʃn jiːldz lɔːŋ tɜːrm ˈbenɪfɪts, ˈɡɪvn ðæt ɪt ɪmˈpruːvz ˈsoʊʃl moʊˈbɪləti/

concept_examples.text: From my perspective, the new policy is flawed, due to the fact that it ignores regional differences.
concept_examples.translation: Arraweeyaan, siyaasadda cusub waxay qalad ah, sababtaas oo ah ay jirin xilkaas oo ay jirto xilkaas oo ay jirto xilkaas.
concept_examples.phonetic: /frɒm maɪ pərˈspektɪv, ðə nuː ˈpɒləsi ɪz flɔːd, djuː tuː ðə fækt ðæt ɪt ɪɡˈnɔːrz ˈriːdʒənl ˈdɪfrənsɪz/

concept_examples.text: It seems to me that we should prioritize renewable energy, otherwise we will face severe climate consequences.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u adag noqono qalabka baakimaha cusub, haddii aan u adag noqonno waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u adag noqono qalabka baakimaha cusub.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪt siːmz tuː miː ðæt wiː ʃʊd praɪˈɒrɪtaɪz rɪˈnjuːəbl ˈenərdʒi, ˈʌðəwaɪz wiː wɪl feɪs sɪˈvɪər ˈklaɪmət ˈkɒnsɪkwənsɪz/

common_error.wrong: According to my opinion, the government should do more for education.
common_error.correct: In my opinion, the government should do more for education.
common_error.correct_alt: From my point of view, the government should do more for education.
common_error.explanation: Af-Soomaaliga waxay nuugu dhahantahay 'según mi opinión' (adag 'according to my opinion'), laakiin af-Ingiriisi ma jiro arrintani; 'according to' waxaa la isticmaalaa macluumaadka kharashka (according to the report). Taarka saxa u ah waxay 'in my opinion' ama 'from my point of view'. Khali kani waa mid amaana ah ee ku dhex marayo kuwo kasahor ah af-Soomaali maxaa yeelahay prepositionka 'según' waxaa adag ah 'according to'.

examples.original: In my view, the film was overrated.
examples.phonetic: /ɪn maɪ vjuː, ðə fɪlm wɒz ˌoʊvərˈreɪtɪd/
examples.translation: Arraweeyaan, fiilku wuxuu ahaa qiiro-qiiro.
examples.note: Isticmaala 'in my view' si aad u siinayo arraaiso rasmi. Waxaad isticmaalayaa 'to my mind' (arraweeyaan) laakiin waa Ingiriisi-Britan.

examples.original: I strongly believe that recycling should be mandatory.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ ˈstrɔːŋli bɪˈliːv ðæt rɪˈsaɪklɪŋ ʃʊd biː ˈmændətɔːri/
examples.translation: Waxaan u maleynayaa si adag in dhexdhexaadka wuxuu u eg yahay.
examples.note: 'Strongly believe' waxay ku darayaa xanuun; af-Soomaaliga waxay nuugu dhahantahay 'waxaan u maleynayaa si adag'.

examples.original: As far as I'm concerned, the project is on track.
examples.phonetic: /æz fɑːr æz aɪm kənˈsɜːrnd, ðə ˈprɒdʒekt ɪz ɒn træk/
examples.translation: Sidee aan u malaynayo, shaqada waa jira.
examples.note: Arrintan waxay u fayfaan inaad u muujisid inaad u siinayo arraaisoadaada shakhsiya.

examples.original: The reason being that prices have risen significantly.
examples.phonetic: /ðə ˈriːzn ˈbiːɪŋ ðæt ˈpraɪsɪz hæv ˈrɪzən sɪɡˈnɪfɪkəntli/
examples.translation: Sababtaas oo ah in qiimaha ay ku badiyeen si adag.
examples.note: Waxaa la isticmaalaa ilaa jeediya sababta ugu horreeya.

examples.original: Due to the lack of funding, the program was cancelled.
examples.phonetic: /djuː tuː ðə læk ɒv ˈfʌndɪŋ, ðə ˈproʊɡræm wɒz ˈkænsəld/
examples.translation: Sababtaas oo ah inaan jirin biasha, shaqada ayaa la xiriireeyey.
examples.note: 'Due to' waa u adag 'because of'. Fiirso 'to' iyo ha iska daahiri 'because'.

examples.original: Given that the economy is unstable, we should be cautious.
examples.phonetic: /ˈɡɪvn ðæt ði ɪˈkɒnəmi ɪz ʌnˈsteɪbl, wiː ʃʊd biː ˈkɔːʃəs/
examples.translation: Maxaa yeelahay in iibka ay jirin, waxaan u maleynayaa inaan u eg yahay inaan u eg yahay.
examples.note: 'Given that' waxay u fayfaan inaad soo bandhigto shart ama xaqiijinta.

examples.original: While it is true that technology has drawbacks, it also opens up new possibilities.
examples.phonetic: /waɪl ɪt ɪz truː ðæt tekˈnɒlədʒi hæz ˈdrɔːbæks, ɪt ˈɔːlsoʊ ˈoʊpənz ʌp nuː ˌpɒsəˈbɪlətiz/
examples.translation: Haddii ay hufan tahay in tachnologygu waa xumanta, ayna furanaysaa calaamo cusub.
examples.note: Xukumkan waxay u oggolaan inaad u muujisid xanuunka laba fikrad.

examples.original: Unless we address climate change now, future generations will suffer.
examples.phonetic: /ənˈles wiː əˈdres ˈklaɪmət tʃeɪndʒ naʊ, ˈfjuːtʃər ˌdʒenəˈreɪʃnz wɪl ˈsʌfər/
examples.translation: Haddii aanan u adag noqonno khaladka dhexdhexaadka, ayuu u adag noqon doonaa khaladka dhexdhexaadka.
examples.note: Isticmaala 'unless' si aad u malaynayo 'haddii aan' (shartiga negative).

examples.original: If the government invested more in healthcare, the overall well-being would improve.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ðə ˈɡʌvənmənt ɪnˈvestɪd mɔːr ɪn ˈhelθkeər, ði ˌoʊvərˈɔːl ˌwelˈbiːɪŋ wʊd ɪmˈpruːv/
examples.translation: Haddii dowladda ay ku shaacaysaa si aan u adag noqonno dhawrsada, ayuu u adag noqon doonaa dhawrsada.
examples.note: Labaad shartiga ah oo ku saabsan khaliyada aan la malaynayn. Af-Ingiriisi, waxay nuugu dhahantahay inaan isticmaalo waqtiga dambeeyay ilaa jeediya 'if'.

title: Hypothesising about the past / Ka fiirsoonaan ee dabeecad
bridge: Faroodka Soomaaliga, si ay u fiirsanayeen dabeecad waxay naga qaadaan 'habría + participio' ama 'hubiera + participio', laakiin faroodka Ingiriisi ah qalabka waa kala duwan: waxay isticmaalayaan 'would have + past participle' si ay u soo baxaan natiijooyinka iyo 'had + past participle' si ay u soo baxaan shartiga (third conditional). Khalad aad u adag waa in la tarjumo 'si habría' si ay u noqoto 'if would have', laakiin faroodka Ingiriisi ah shartiga ma hayaan 'would'. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, faroodka Ingiriisi ah waxay leeyihiin 'might have' iyo 'could have' si ay u soo baxaan awood ama suuragal, oo faroodka Soomaaliga ayaa badan oo la tarjumayaa 'podría haber' ama 'quizás habría'.
rule: Si ay u fiirsanayeen dabeecad faroodka Ingiriisi ah, waxaa isticmaalayaa 'third conditional' iyo qalabka midaba ah oo dhan. Qalabka ugu muhiimsan waa: 'If + past perfect (had + participle), would have + past participle'. Misal: 'If I had studied, I would have passed'. Waxaa isticmaalayaa midabo: 'could have' (awood ama suuragal), 'might have' (suuragal), 'should have' (tashriic ama gargaarka). Hadalka xog ku celis ama hadalka doonista, waxaa isticmaalayaa 'wish + past perfect' (ojalá hubiera). 'Would have' ma isticmaali karo shartiga 'if'. Su'aasha, waxaa la beddelaa shaxarka: 'Would you have...?'

concept_examples.text: If I had known, I would have told you.
concept_examples.translation: Haddii aanay ogayn, waxaan ku odhan lahaa.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ɪf aɪ hæd noʊn, aɪ wʊd hæv toʊld juː/

concept_examples.text: She might have missed the train.
concept_examples.translation: Ayay u qalin lahaa qalabka.
concept_examples.phonetic: /ʃiː maɪt hæv mɪst ðə treɪn/

concept_examples.text: We could have won the match.
concept_examples.translation: Waxaynu u qalin lahaa ina keenno shaxda.
concept_examples.phonetic: /wiː kʊd hæv wʌn ðə mætʃ/

concept_examples.text: I wish I had studied more.
concept_examples.translation: Sidee baan u jeclaan lahaa inaan ka badan u akhrinayay.
concept_examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd ˈstʌdɪd mɔːr/

common_error.wrong: If I would have known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct: If I had known, I would have told you.
common_error.correct_alt: Had I known, I would have told you.
common_error.explanation: Khaladkan waxay noqotaa maxaa yeelay faroodka Soomaaliga waxay leeyahay 'Si hubiera sabido' qaarkood tarjumayaal 'hubiera' si ay u noqoto 'would have', laakiin faroodka Ingiriisi ah shartiga 'if' ma hayaan 'would'. Waxaa in la isticmaalayaa 'had + participio' shartiga. Si aad u jeedin lahaa, xusuuso in 'would' keliya ayaa muujiyaa shartiga natiijada. Badanka kala duwan waa in la beddelaa shaxarka iyo 'had': 'Had I known...'.

examples.original: If she had left earlier, she wouldn't have missed the flight.
examples.phonetic: /ɪf ʃiː hæd lɛft ˈɜːrliər, ʃiː ˈwʊdnt hæv mɪst ðə flaɪt/
examples.translation: Haddii ay ka hor tageen, ayay ma tixraacin lahaa adeegga.
examples.note: Qalabka kaamil ah: 'If + past perfect, would not have + participio'.

examples.original: They would have arrived on time if the traffic hadn't been so bad.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ wʊd hæv əˈraɪvd ɒn taɪm ɪf ðə ˈtræfɪk ˈhædnt biːn soʊ bæd/
examples.translation: Waxay u noqdeen waqtiisa haddii dabadeeddu ma aha mid aan u fiicanayn.
examples.note: Shartiga 'if' waxay u noqon kartaa dhexdhexaad ilma ah.

examples.original: You should have called me.
examples.phonetic: /juː ʃʊd hæv kɔːld miː/
examples.translation: Waxaa in lahaa inaad i soo xiriirtay.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'should have' si ay u soo baxaan gargaarka ama xumaan.

examples.original: He could have been a doctor.
examples.phonetic: /hiː kʊd hæv biːn ə ˈdɒktər/
examples.translation: Wuxuu u qalin lahaa inuu noqdo da’i.
examples.note: U soo baxay awood ama suuragal aan la sameynin.

examples.original: They might have forgotten the meeting.
examples.phonetic: /ðeɪ maɪt hæv fərˈɡɒtn ðə ˈmiːtɪŋ/
examples.translation: Waxay u qalin lahaa inay nala hadlain la kulanko.
examples.note: U soo baxay suuragal aan la yaqinayn dabeecad.

examples.original: I wish I had accepted the job offer.
examples.phonetic: /aɪ wɪʃ aɪ hæd əkˈsɛptɪd ðə dʒɒb ˈɒfər/
examples.translation: Sidee baan u jeclaan lahaa inaan qabtay shaqo.
examples.note: Isticmaalka 'wish + past perfect' si ay u soo baxaan xumaan.

examples.original: If only we had listened to the weather forecast.

title: Discussing abstract concepts / Hadal furan oo ku saabsan xusumooyin caqliga ah
bridge: Faransiiska, inoo ogolaanaya inaanu soo bandhigmo xusumooyin caqliga ah wuxuu kuu bixiyaa 'subjunctive' ('waxaa muhiim in...', 'waxaan u maleynayaa in uu noqoto...') iyo xogta caqliga ah. Ingiriishi, isticmaalka 'subjunctive' waa u badan yaraadeed: waxay ku xidhan tahay fiicil 'suggest', 'recommend', 'demand', iyo hadalka 'it is essential that...'. Si kastaba ha ahaatee, Ingiriishi, magacyada caqliga ah oo 'freedom' ama 'justice' ah ayay ku tushan yihiin isagoo aan la isticmaalo magac liiska oo ay ku jiraan 'the' markii ay hadlayaan kuwo ku salaysan, oo isaga oo kale ayuu ku jiraa 'the' ('the freedom'). Waxaad ogolaan doontaa in Ingiriishi ayuu kuu bixiyaa 'do' si loo weydiiyo iyo si loo diido, oo ay ku jiraan mid hoose oo ku salaysan.
rule: Si aad u hadashid xusumooyin caqliga ah Ingiriishi degmo B2, waa inaad qabashid: 1. Magacyada caqliga ah oo ay ku jiraan singular/plural oo aan la isticmaalin 'zero article' si loo hadlato kuwo ku salaysan ('Freedom is important' vs 'La libertad es importante'). 2. Jumlayaasha soo jeeda oo ay ku jiraan 'that' + fiicilka asasiga (subjunctive) oo ay ku dhexeen fiicilka tashil ama talab ('I suggest that she be...') iyo mid hoose oo ku salaysan ('It is crucial that he attend'). 3. Xogta caqliga ah si loo soo bandhigmo: 'In my opinion', 'I believe that', 'It seems to me that', isticmaalka 'indicative' (isagoo ka soo baxay 'subjunctive' oo ay ku jiraan Faransiiska). 4. Isticmaalka 'which' iyo 'that' si loo soo bandhigmo iyo si loo soo bandhigmo. 5. Fiicilka 'modal' si loo soo bandhigmo: 'might', 'could', 'would', 'should' si loo soo bandhigmo suuragal, shart ama tashil. 6. Hadalka aan la qaadan karin oo ay ku jiraan 'it' ('It is obvious that', 'It is worth considering'). Xusuuso in Ingiriishi ma jiro diidden diidden, oo xogta jumlayaasha ayuu ku jiraa Subject + Fiicil + Object.

title: Expressing complex emotions / Sharci u fahmi dhirirro xanuun
bridge: In Spanish, we often use verbs like 'estar' + adjective or 'sentirse' to express emotions, but in English, more varied structures are used, such as compound adjectives, prepositional phrases, and figurative language. A common mistake is to literally translate 'tengo miedo de' as 'I have fear of' instead of 'I'm afraid of'. Additionally, English distinguishes nuances that Spanish does not always mark with different words, such as 'frustrated' (frustrado) vs. 'annoyed' (molesto), or 'overwhelmed' (abrumado) which has no exact equivalent. Pay attention to prepositions and adjectives that change meaning depending on the preposition.
rule: To express complex emotions in English, the following are mainly used: 1) Adjectives with fixed prepositions: 'angry about/at', 'frustrated with', 'disappointed in/with', 'excited about', 'worried about', 'ashamed of', 'proud of'. 2) Structures with 'feel' + adjective or 'feel like' + gerund for internal emotions. 3) Verbs like 'get' + adjective for emotional state changes (get frustrated, get overwhelmed). 4) Compound adjectives with hyphens for complex emotions: 'homesick', 'heartbroken', 'overwhelmed'. 5) Idioms for intense emotions: 'on cloud nine' (very happy), 'down in the dumps' (depressed). Remember that 'nervous' is used for anxiety, 'anxious' can imply intense concern; 'upset' is stronger than 'sad'. Do not use 'I have' with emotions in English, except in expressions like 'I have a feeling'.

title: Formal Writing: Reports and Emails / Bookha qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail
bridge: Faransiiska, qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail waxay u dhexeeya inay noqoto qoraal weyn oo ay qaybta qoraalka u qayb qaata jira. Ingiriishi, xogta iyo barashada e-mail waxay u dhexeeya inay noqoto qoraal qiiro iyo qayb qaato. Khalad aad u xiiso ah wuxuu u dhexeeya inuu tarjama qoraalka 'Le adjunto' si 'I attach' (khalaad) oo kale 'Please find attached' ama 'I have attached'. Ingiriishi, qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail waxay u dhexeeya inay noqoto qoraal qiiro iyo qayb qaato. Ingiriishi, qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail waxay u dhexeeya inay noqoto qoraal qiiro iyo qayb qaato.
rule: Si aad u qorato qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail Ingiriishi, waxaad u baahan doontaa inaad isticmaalashid tawaal qaato qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail Ingiriishi: 1) Tawaal qaato qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail: 'Dear Mr. Smith', 'Dear Madam', 'Yours sincerely', 'Yours faithfully'. 2) Tawaal qaato qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail: 'state' (oo kale 'say'), 'require' (oo kale 'need'), 'I would like to' (oo kale 'I want'), 'I am writing to inform you'. 3) Tawaal qaato qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail: qoraal qiiro, qayb qaato, iyo soo bandhig. 4) Tawaal qaato qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail: 'do not' (oo kale 'don't'), 'I would' (oo kale 'I'd'). 5) Si aad u qorato qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail: isticmaal tawaal qaato qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail 'Introduction', 'Findings', 'Recommendations', iyo qoraal qiiro 'It was found that...' (Waxaa la ooyay in...). 6) Tawaal qaato qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail: 'Could you please...', 'I would appreciate...', 'Would it be possible to...?'. Xusuuso in Ingiriishi, qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail 'please' ma isticmaalino dhammaan jirka qoraalka (waxay u dhexeeya inay noqoto qoraal qiiro), laakiin waxay isticmaalayaa qoraalka xogta iyo barashada e-mail ama horay.

title: Dealing with Conflict / Xaalad iyo su’aashaad u dhaqmi
bridge: Af-Soomaaliga, waxay nuu ogolaan inaan amri u qayb galno ('Ila haddii wax ku dhacay') ama qoraallo 'waad u baahan tahay' si loo xal gudo xaalad. Ingiriisi, mar walba, waa mid ugu muhiim ah adag iyo kharash: waxaa la isticmaalaa fiil qalab mood 'could' iyo 'might', iyo jumo 'Waxaan u maleynayaa...' mala fudud u qayb galaya. Khilaaf badan oo kiciya waxaa laguu tarjumayaa 'aad u baahan tahay' 'you must', oo u dhexeeyaa qofka; haddaba, waxaa laguu isticmaalaa 'you might want to' ama 'maybe you could'.
rule: Xaalad u dhaqmi Ingiriisi B2, waxaa laguu isticmaalaa isticmaalka adag iyo luqad aan xumaysan. Deegaankii ugu muhiimsan waxay tahay: 1) Fiil qalab mood oo loo soo jeedo su’aalo xanuun: 'could', 'might', 'would' (misaal 'Waxaynuu qabannaa inaynuu jarayno...'). 2) Hadlayaasha ra’yi shakhsi ah oo leh 'Waxaan u maleynayaa', 'Waxaan u maleynayaa', 'Waxaan rumaynayaa' si loo oggolaado ayuu ku qayb galay. 3) Qoraallada shartiga ah oo loo soo jeedo xaalad: 'Haddii aad..., waxaynuu qabannaa...'. 4) Jumo oo loo soo jeedo adag: 'Waxaan ogahay', 'Waxaan arkay qaybtaada'. 5) Su’aalo aan xumaysan: 'Waxaan ku fiirnay haddii aad u qabannaa...'. 6) Isticmaalka 'sorry' si loo adeego xumaan aan xumaysan: 'Waxaan ka xumahay haddii ayay ku soo baxay xumaan'. Mala fudud u qayb galaya iyo su’aalo oo leh 'you' (misaal 'Aad jirtaa khalad') maxaa yeelay waxay u dhexeeyaan qofka. Haddaba, isticmaala 'Ma iibsan inaynuu u eg yahay' ama 'Waxaan u maleynayaa kala duwan'.

title: Summarising and Paraphrasing / Ku qoran galin iyo ku hadashidhin
bridge: Faransiis, waxaan ku hadashidhinayaa 'waxyaabahaas', 'sideeda', iyo 'ku qoran galinta', laakiin Ingiriisi waxaa lagu qorataa kala duwan oo lagu qorataa bilowga ama dhexdhexaadka eachadiisa qiyaastii. Fiirso: Ingiriisi ma ayusan isticmaalayaan 'in summary' sida 'in short' ama 'to sum up', iyo fiilka 'summarize' waxaa la hadlayaa xaaladda ugu horreysa. Kala duwan kale waxaa ah in Faransiis waxaan ku dhabadheenayaa isku darka, Ingiriisi waxaa lagu qorataa isticmaalka isku darka iyo ku qoran galinta, laakiin isku darka ma ayiha noqon karo eachad oo buuxan.
rule: Si aad u qorid qoran galin iyo ku hadashidhin Ingiriisi B2, fiilashadayaa 'summarize', 'paraphrase', 'outline', 'restate', iyo xirfad 'in other words', 'that is', 'to put it briefly', 'in a nutshell', 'to sum up', 'in short', 'all in all' iyo 'to recap'. Xirfhada ugu muhiimsanaa waxay tahay: [Xirfada] + [eachada la qoray qoran galinta]. Marka aad ku hadashidhidhiso, xirfhada eachada (sida uu yahay codka nolosha inuu noqdo codka nolosha ama eachada hoose inuu noqdo magaca) laakiin maanta waxaa la qorataa maanaheeda. Tusaale ahaan: 'The study reveals a significant increase...' → 'In other words, the numbers went up a lot.' Si aad u qorid qoran galin qoraal, bilaabmay 'The text is about...' ama 'The author argues that...'. Ka tiradaa tarjumaadka 'in summary' 'in summary' qoraalka aan u adag; dooro 'in short' ama 'to sum up'. Fiirso isticmaalka 'actually' (waxay tihiin 'in reality', aan 'currently' ahayn), laakiin qoran galinta waxaa lagu qorataa 'in fact' ama 'actually'.

title: Using Idioms Naturally / Isticmaalka abwaanaysa af-cadaan
bridge: Faransiiska, abwaanaysuugu yihiin ujeed u dhexeeya oo badan oo ka kooban yihiin fiicil 'tener' ama 'estar' (sida, 'estar como una cabra'). Ingiriishi, abwaanays badan oo ka kooban yihiin fiicil fali iyo magacyo xaqiiqo ah, oo badan yihiin qaawan oo toos. Khilaad caadi ahaan waa abwaanaysa faransiiska si adag u turjumaya ingiriishi (sida, 'to have a good face' kala duwan 'to be in a good mood'). Ingiriishi, fiicil 'to be' badan oo ka kooban yihiin xogta 'be over the moon', oo faransiiska fiicil 'estar' ama 'tener' isticmaalayo. Fiirso diiwaangelinta: abwaanays baa u yihiin ammaan ah ('kick the bucket') oo kalese baa u yihiin adag ('pass away').
rule:
Si aad u isticmaalo abwaanaysa ingiriishi si cadaan, raadin xuduudkaas:
1. Baaro abwaanaysa sida ay yihiin, aan la qaybiyin.
2. Oga diiwaangelinta: rasmi ah, aan rasmi ahayn, qaawan ama adag. Sida dheer, 'to be over the moon' aan rasmi ahayn, laakiin 'to be delighted' waa rasmi badan.
3. Abwaanays badan oo ka kooban yihiin maana la yaqaan karo aan la ogaain karo magacyada. Sida dheer, 'break the ice' ma u maano qaybinta ice, laakiin bilaabmaynta su'aasha qaybta qalad.
4. Abwaanaysa waxay ku noqdaan madax madaxa, laakiin qoraalka akhbaariga ama shaqaalaha waxay u isticmaalaan si qoto dheer.
5. Abwaanays baa u yihiin kala duwan gobol (sida, 'to be in hot water' ingiriishi mareeggan vs. 'to be in a pickle' laba gobol).
6. title: Academic and Professional Register / Qoraalka Akademic iyo Waxbarashada
bridge: Ingiriisiiska akademic iyo waxbarashada, xaaladda iyo adagga waa la heli karo waxaad u adeegsan tahay qorallooyinka aan shakhsi ahayn, miisaanka u dhexeeya iibka iyo mishaarka, waxaana ayaan ku fiicni doonaa inaan u adeegsanayo codka aan shakhsi ahayn iyo qorallooyinka aan shakhsi ahayn sida 'se' ama 'uno'. Khalad aad u xiiso ah ee bukaanka afka Spanish waa tarjumaadda adagga ah ee qoraalka aan shakhsi ahayn ('Waxay leeyihiin in...' → 'Se dice que...') oo aan ogayn in Ingiriisi wuxuu u baahan yahay shaxsiga qoraalka ama qoraal aan shakhsi ahayn oo buuxo leh. Waxa ugu muhiimnaa isticmaalka 'would', 'could' iyo 'might' si loo khalad gaaro qaybo, waxaana ayaan ku fiicni doonaa inaan u adeegsanayo shartaalka ('podría ser') laakiin Ingiriisi wuxuu u baahan yahay miisaanka u dhexeeya iibka iyo mishaarka ugu badan oo leh qoraalka aan 'to' ahayn. Ka tira mana fiicni doono: 'can' iyo 'will' waa la qalimoonaa, laakiin qoraalka rasmi ah waa la doonayaa 'may' iyo 'would'.
rule: Ingiriisiiska rasmi ah ee akademic iyo waxbarashada, waa la doonayaa isticmaalka qoraalka aan shakhsi ahayn ('Waxay la go'aansaday...') malaa'ishii qoraalka shakhsi ah ('Aanu go'aansannaay...') si loo iyago qoraalka shakhsi ah. Miisaanka u dhexeeya iibka iyo mishaarka ('may', 'might', 'could') waxay u adeegsan yihiin inay soo bixiyaan qaybta aan xaaladda ahayn, oo 'would' baa loo isticmaalayaa adagga shartaalka. Mishaarka (qoraalka verb si ay u noqoto noun, e.g., 'to decide' → 'decision') waxay nuqday qoraalka akademic. Qoraalka qoraalka, waxay ka tashiifaa qoraalka qoraalka (don't → do not), oo waxay u adeegsan yihiin qoraalka rasmi ah sida 'however', 'furthermore', 'nevertheless'. Kala duwan, Spanishka rasmi ah waxay ku fiicni doonaa inaan u adeegsanayo qoraalka shakhsi ah iyo qorallooyinka 'se', iyo shartaalka aad u sarreeya ('sería', 'podría') si ay u adkayaan. Xusuuso in Ingiriisi ma hayo xiriir jinsiga/qoraalka, laakiin wuxuu u baahan yahay shaxsiga qoraalka (illaa imperatives) oo qoraalka qoraalka waxay u adag tahay. B2, waa inaad qabsato qoraalka aan shakhsi ahayn ee waqtiga aad u sarreeya, miisaanka u dhexeeya iibka iyo mishaarka ee waqtiga hadda iyo dhibta ('could have done'), oo isticmaalka 'would' shartaalka adagga.
